# Admin Controls, Account Lifecycle Purge & Session Truthfulness Checklist: Native Instagram Engine

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review checklist validating administrative AI containment, complete account lifecycle purge across SQLite/RAM/MQTT, session health state fidelity, and native sync determinism.
**Created**: 2026-10-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on user-identified boundary conditions and core architecture principles.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## 1. Administrative AI Engine Configuration & Access Control

- [ ] CHK001 Are AI model selection and provider API key configuration explicitly restricted to the Backoffice (`/backoffice`) interface? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the AI configuration interface explicitly excluded from per-account tenant navigation sidebars to prevent unauthorized exposure? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK003 Are API key masking standards (e.g. `sk-...abcd`) and secure credential updating behaviors clearly defined for multi-provider support (Gemini vs. OpenAI)? [Clarity, Security]
- [ ] CHK004 Does the specification define fallback behaviors when AI keys are unconfigured, invalid, or exhausted by quota limits? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK005 Are live connection test requirements and latency timeout constraints specified for the administrative AI panel? [Measurability, Spec §FR-014]

## 2. Comprehensive Account Deletion & Cryptographic Session Purge

- [ ] CHK006 Are complete cascading deletion requirements documented across all persistent SQLite tables (`accounts`, `account_sessions`, `dm_automations`, `dm_logs`, `posts`, `comment_logs`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK007 Does the specification mandate immediate invalidation and memory purging of volatile `instagrapi.Client` instances in Python RAM upon account deletion? [Clarity, Security, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK008 Are thread termination and teardown requirements explicitly specified for background MQTT listeners when an account is removed? [Coverage, Concurrency]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the failure and recovery behavior defined if the Next.js control plane fails to notify the native Python engine during an account deletion request? [Exception Flow, Resilience]
- [ ] CHK010 Are user confirmation and irreversible data loss warnings specified in compliance with global UX standards before purge execution? [UX Standard, Principle XIII]

## 3. Session Health Truthfulness & Default State Fidelity

- [ ] CHK011 Is the default session state for freshly added or unauthenticated accounts explicitly mandated as `unauthenticated` rather than `active`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK012 Does the specification define strict falsifiable criteria for when the top health badge may display the green `نشست: فعال` indicator? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK013 Are visual state transitions and banner triggers defined when an account's session is deleted or purged from the database? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the immediate re-login dialog trigger specified when an operator attempts to access features of an unauthenticated or purged account? [Acceptance Criteria, User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK015 Are engine-level session vault verification requirements enforced on every client retrieval before returning a cached session? [Security, Spec §FR-006]

## 4. Native Catalog Sync Determinism & Error Transparency

- [ ] CHK016 Are synchronization requirements formulated to execute synchronously against the native Python engine instead of dispatching to legacy background job queues? [Consistency, Architecture]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the immediate error response contract (`{ success: false, error, session_required: true }`) specified when syncing unauthenticated accounts? [Clarity, API Contract]
- [ ] CHK018 Does the specification require the frontend to immediately present the 1-click re-login modal upon encountering `session_required` during a sync operation? [Coverage, User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK019 Are timeout thresholds (e.g. 15-second mobile endpoint ceiling) and partial post sync scenarios defined with measurable metrics? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK020 Are loading states, spinner feedback, and toast notification microcopy defined in Persian and Arabic per tone-of-voice standards? [Completeness, Principle V]

## 5. Multi-Tenant Isolation & Concurrency Integrity

- [ ] CHK021 Are tenant boundary rules defined to guarantee that account sessions and comments from one tenant are never accessible to another? [Security, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK022 Are MQTT client client-ID and topic namespace isolation requirements documented for multi-account concurrent operations? [Coverage, Concurrency]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the database transaction atomicity requirement specified for account and session deletion to prevent orphaned database records? [Consistency, Data Integrity]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
